name: Flowers Hurricane
body:
School evocation [air]; Level druid 4, hunter 4, ranger 4, shaman 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a live blossom)

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Effect line-shaped gust of wind emanating out from you to the extreme of the range
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none or Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as gust of wind, but the blast also carries a multitude of blossoms, leaves, and sprigs, inflicting 5d6 damage to all creatures in its path. Half of this is bludgeoning damage and half slashing damage. A target can save normally against the wind’s effects, but cannot avoid the damage.
